title: Talentless Nana
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Superpowered children called the Talented are sent to an island school to train against the 'Enemies of Humanity'. Cheerful transfer student Nana Hiiragi claims to read minds, but she is a powerless government assassin secretly killing her classmates, whom the state sees as the real threat. Immortal student Kyoya Onodera suspects her, and the story widens into a conspiracy and island civil war.
life_message: Questioned more than stated: who is the real enemy, and can a person trained to kill choose trust and friendship instead?
